analysis_scope.selection_rule: The two application groups and D5 replications 1, 2, and 3 are fixed in advance; no case is selected using precision outcomes.
analysis_scope.model: original alpha=1 factorial prior and empirical joint-partition mode

sampling_budget.conditional_extension: A fresh, separately labelled 100000-iteration run is permitted only when the original-budget comparison fails a prespecified accuracy threshold; original trajectories remain immutable.

estimands_and_checks.intervals: For every DGP and trial, pointwise coverage, interval width, replication-level Monte Carlo standard error, and near/far summaries; near means distance <=2 from a true cut.
estimands_and_checks.paired_rmse: Within-replication mean trajectory-RMSE differences for all method pairs in D0-D5, with special CG-RJMCMC minus PELT-BIC reporting and paired Monte Carlo standard errors.
estimands_and_checks.trajectory_diagnostics: Rank-normalized split R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS, and 0.025/0.975 quantile MCSE for all 64 trajectory coordinates.
estimands_and_checks.discrete_diagnostics: K plus every P(K=k) and boundary-PIP indicator; constant estimands are N/A and certified against exact posterior probabilities rather than assigned artificial ESS.
estimands_and_checks.exact_posterior: Enumerate all 27931 legal partitions with C-kernel log weights; compute p(K), boundary PIP, BMA mean, top-partition ranks, and marginal Student-t mixture quantiles at all 64 coordinates using df=2a_n and scale=sqrt((b_n/a_n)*diag(A_n^{-1})).

accuracy_thresholds.endpoint_alternative: If an endpoint exceeds 0.002, report its quantile MCSE and exact error explicitly; do not claim it passed.
accuracy_thresholds.tail_ess: No blanket requirement that every tail ESS exceed 1500; adequacy is judged against exact posterior error.
